role: The read-size accountant: each tag read reports its byte cost and a RuntimeException stops a read that would exceed the tracker's limit; the static instance is the unlimited tracker.
scope_reason: Every binary NBT read in the game goes through a tracker; the engine's readers must not accept input the JVM would refuse.

notes: The unlimited static tracker is what the file and stream readers in game code pass (CompressedStreamTools.read(File) and read(DataInputStream)); the one finite limit in the game is PacketBuffer.readNBTTagCompoundFromBuffer's 2097152-byte tracker on network tile-entity and book reads, and the native readers carry no budget there either, so a too-big network NBT would be accepted where Java throws. Engine-only reads (snapshots, regions) are the proven paths: test_snapshots.c. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the budget only guards network NBT, which native never parses. Formerly listed as missing: The size accounting and the too-big throw (func_152450_a with a finite limit, used by PacketBuffer.readNBTTagCompoundFromBuffer for network tile-entity NBT): no native reader carries a budget.
